entities.name: Apes
entities.description: A creature type for apes found throughout the Multiverse, mainly in forest habitats.

entities.name: Gorillas of Yavimaya
entities.description: Sentient tribal gorillas of Yavimaya led by Gorilla Chieftains, allied with the elves.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Forest on Dominaria home to sentient gorillas.

entities.name: Gorilla Chieftain
entities.description: Leader of the Yavimayan gorillas who had Laina and Kaysa brought to him and allied with the elves.

entities.name: Laina
entities.description: Elf brought before a Gorilla Chieftain.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Elf brought before a Gorilla Chieftain.

entities.name: Heart of Yavimaya
entities.description: Center of Yavimaya's corruption, attacked and cleansed.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: War in which Yavimayan gorillas fought in the battles for Yavimaya and Urborg.

entities.name: Barbar
entities.description: Place whose apes are savage carnivores.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: Plane where Fang Druid gorillas live hidden in the jungles.

entities.name: Fang Druids
entities.description: Gorillas and humans hidden in Muraganda's jungles, attuned to the plane's heartbeat.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: Tarkir clan that uses mandrills from Gurmag Swamp for dark agendas.

entities.name: Kheru City
entities.description: Tarkir city watched by Jade-Cast Sentinels.

events.summary: A Gorilla Chieftain has Laina and Kaysa brought to him and allies his people with the elves against the Heart of Yavimaya.
events.quote: he allied his people with the elves , and aided in the attack against the Heart of Yavimaya , which cleansed the forest

relations.quote: Muraganda 's most frequently-seen apes are the gorilla members of the Fang Druids
